description: Defines the interface and classes for scheme, host, and port matching rules used in URL filtering within the Chromium project. Includes classes for hostname pattern matching, IP address matching, and IP block range matching.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule
classes.description: Abstract base class for URL scheme, host, and port matching rules.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherHostnamePatternRule
classes.description: Matches URLs with hostname patterns, including wildcards, and optional scheme and port restrictions.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPHostRule
classes.description: Matches URLs with IP address as hostname, with optional scheme and port restrictions.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherIPBlockRule
classes.description: Matches URLs with IP addresses within a specified numeric range, with optional scheme.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule::FromUntrimmedRawString
methods.description: Creates a matcher rule by parsing a raw string, returning nullptr if parsing fails.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule::Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the rule against a given URL, returning the match result.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the rule.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherRule::IsHostnamePatternRule
methods.description: Checks if the rule is a hostname pattern rule.

methods.name: SchemeHostPortMatcherHostnamePatternRule::GenerateSuffixMatchingRule
methods.description: Creates a new hostname pattern rule that does suffix matching.
